abstract: Torsion of ovarian tumors occurred predominantly in the reproductive age group. The majority of the cases presented in pregnant (22.7%) than in non-pregnant (6.1%) women. The major presenting symptom was pain but an abdominal mass was palpable in 79.4% of cases. Torsion was more common on the right ovary and 50% were gangrenous at laparotomy. Most of the tumors were benign cystic teratomas. Only 8.7% of the tumors were malignant.
abstract_ja: 卵巣腫瘍の捻転は主に生殖年齢の女性に生じた。妊娠中の症例（22.7%）は非妊娠例（6.1%）より多かった。主な症状は疼痛であったが、79.4%の症例で腹部腫瘤が触知された。捻転は右側卵巣により多く、50%は開腹時に壊疽性であった。腫瘍の多くは良性嚢胞性奇形腫であり、悪性腫瘍は8.7%にすぎなかった。
